title: drone attack kills two children burns logistics hub russias krasnodar 2026 08 24
text:
Aug 24 (Reuters) - Two children were killed and another nine people, including seven children, ​were injured after drone debris hit a private ‌childcare centre in Krasnodar, southern Russia, overnight, Governor Veniamin Kondratyev said.
In Ukraine, a Russian attack on the outskirts of the northeastern ​city of Kharkiv killed three people, the governor said ​on Telegram late on Sunday. Ukraine is seeking additional ⁠interceptor missiles from the U.S. and Europe, its ​key allies, to repel such attacks, in its fifth year ​of war with Russia.
Debris fell on apartment buildings and warehouses caught fire in Krasnodar, Kondratyev said on the Telegram messaging app. The ​attack caused a fire at a logistics hub ​of Russian online retailer Ozon, the company said on Telegram.
In Russia's Nevinnomysk, a ‌chemical ⁠production area in the Stavropol region next to Krasnodar, a drone attack on an industrial area was repelled, Governor Vladimir Vladimirov said on Telegram early on Monday.
Ukraine has ​stepped up attacks ​on logistics ⁠hubs and warehouses across Russia, bringing the war which Russia started in February 2022 closer to ​ordinary Russians, some of whom make their ​living ⁠from selling goods online.
In comments published on Saturday, Russian President Vladimir Putin said that Kyiv had opened a "Pandora's box" with ⁠its strikes ​on Russian economic targets and ​that Moscow would hit back at Ukraine's "most sensitive economic sectors".
